Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Executar a extensão de rede e a interligação em rede existente, oferecendo serviço de abastecimento de água;

  • Realizar a aferição da pressão de rede de distribuição de água e medidores;

Gerenciar doações de recursos filantrópicos em projetos, coalizões e advocacy, conduzindo o time para resultados efetivos dentro dos temas do Eixo Programático de atuação, com foco prioritário em política climática e economia.

  • Apoiar os donatários na elaboração e revisão de propostas de doação, garantindo alinhamento aos objetivos estratégicos do iCS.
  • Monitorar a implementação dos projetos por meio de reuniões, ferramentas e avaliações, buscando maximizar os resultados e o impacto no campo.
  • Dar suporte aos donatários quanto às estratégias de atuação dos projetos e no relacionamento com todos os atores ligados, direta ou indiretamente, ao Eixo Programático.
  • Avaliar relatórios intermediários e finais de andamento dos projetos, elaborando pareceres internos e externos.
  • Contribuir para o processo de avaliação e monitoramento e com a identificação e sistematização de impactos alcançados atendendo às demandas da Diretoria Programática e da Área de Avaliação e Monitoramento.
  • Elaborar apresentações com os resultados e repercussões dos projetos do Eixo Programático para reuniões do Conselho e outros eventos demandados pela Diretoria Programática e Diretoria Executiva.
  • Realizar representação institucional nacional e internacional em fóruns designados pelas diretorias do iCS.
  • Contribuir para o trabalho da Área de Comunicação Institucional, organizando documentos e fornecendo informações e referências relevantes para os canais e audiências do iCS.
  • Contribuir para o bom relacionamento com doadores, atendendo às demandas da Diretoria de Relações Institucionais no trabalho de fundraising e nas demandas pontuais de financiadores.
  • Pesquisar e redigir documentos técnicos, artigos, sínteses e destaques para divulgação em mídias, eventos, imprensa, financiadores e parceiros, com foco em política climática, economia do clima e finanças climáticas.
  • Gerir e executar o orçamento do Eixo Programático de forma estratégica e eficaz.
  • Redigir Termos de Referência para contratação de serviços do Eixo Programático, conforme política interna.

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Direito, Relações Internacionais, Gestão Pública ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mestrado ou doutorado, preferencialmente com foco em economia do clima, finanças climáticas ou política econômica.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos, com atuação no terceiro setor, preferencialmente em entidades filantrópicas e em cargos de gestão e alta influência.
  • Conhecimento sobre política climática doméstica e internacional.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipe.

  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de projetos, como Salesforce.

O que esperamos de você | Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Responsividade, Dinamismo, agilidade, Atitude propositiva, Iniciativa, Trabalho EM e ENTRE equipes, Comprometimento, Criatividade, Atenção aos detalhes, Comunicação assertiva, Solução de problemas, Organização, Respeito e tolerância à diversidade.

Modelo de Contratação

CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi Case

CEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.
  • Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil.
  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech.

Our Values

  • Trust: Promote transparency and kindness.
  • Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose.
  • Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference.

We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness.

description:
The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes

Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

Descrição Resumida do Cargo

O/a Supervisor/a Operacional será responsável por atuar no acompanhamento e na organização das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento, dos prazos e dos procedimentos operacionais. A função é essencial para assegurar a qualidade da execução, o suporte à equipe operacional e o alinhamento das ações às diretrizes institucionais.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar, orientar e apoiar a equipe de monitores no desempenho de suas atividades;
  • Planejar, em conjunto com o Time Educativo da Light, as atividades pedagógicas e culturais do projeto;
  • Organizar horários de trabalho, controlar a frequência e monitorar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar as atividades operacionais da Exposição;
  • Garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado ao público e a experiência dos visitantes;
  • Zelar pela correta utilização, organização e preservação dos espaços de exposição;

  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios técnicos e dos indicadores de projeto correspondentes.

É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde está preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêitos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Data Platform role at Canonical

Canonical is building a comprehensive suite of multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. We want to make it easy to operate any database on any cloud, or on premise. The data platform team covers the full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines like Postgres and MySQL. We aim to deliver fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems, and the world's best data platform.
We are looking for technical Engineering Managers to lead teams focused on Big Data and MySQL databases. We write code in Python and encode modern operational practices for data applications at scale on Kubernetes and cloud machines.
Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East, African or any American region / time zone.
What your day will look like

  • You will lead a team building scalable data solutions for Kubernetes and cloud machines
  • You will hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback, and lead your team by example
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering skill by directly contributing code when needed
  • Effectively set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate modern, agile software development practices
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Ensure that your team delivers excellent products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture aligned with the company's values.
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization
  • Work from home with global travel twice yearly, for internal events of one or two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • A software engineering background, preferably with Python and Golang experience
  • Experience running in production and at scale, preferably Big Data or MySQL
  • Excellent judgement about people - their motivations, abilities, developmental needs, and prospects for success
  • Proven ability to build high-quality, open-source software
  • Proven to drive good engineering practices around performance and quality
  • An open-minded attitude to new technologies and the drive to push the boundaries of what is possible
  • The ambition to build products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • Love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Knowledgeable and passionate about software development
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Specialist knowledge in one or more of Spark, Superset, MySQL, or similar
  • Prior experience working with open source and a will to build products with the community
What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the \'Control Room\' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \'Visualizations\' and that the \'Data Pipelines\' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • 1 0+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Analista Operações Logísticas, AMXL
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.

A day in the life

Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados.

Requirements

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo.
  • Inglês básico.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • SQL e outras linguagens de programação.
  • Experiência em Logística, e/ou Transportes de itens volumosos e pesados.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards

  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting

  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch

  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals

  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

If you’re passionate about student growth and excited by the idea of working with learners from around the world, we invite you to express your interest. Please submit your CV and we’ll be in touch when a suitable opportunity becomes available.

  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • With the ability to dedicate at least 15-20 hours weekly for 6-9 months once you take a student.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Primary

Crimson Global Academy is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We are doing this by:

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting-edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education.

If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning—apply now!

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

Paths to Work on the Project

    • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.

    • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

    • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.

  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.

  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.

Overview

Manager, Venue Technology role at FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Description

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue-specific technology deliverables for the FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties to plan, implement, ensure readiness, and operate all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and associated events within Brazil.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s).
  • Manage a diverse Venue Technology team comprising paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s).
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, clients, providers, and government entities to deliver technology services across all venues according to the defined governance structure.
  • Contribute to the venue technology working groups across planning, implementation, readiness and operations.
  • Manage technology demand/needs for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process).
  • Plan delivery of end-user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables.
  • Coordinate collection and distribution of technology requirements from all client groups involved in FWWC 2027 (Media, Broadcast, Guest Operations, Commercial, Football Technology, etc.).
  • Ensure information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for delivery and support of technology services is communicated to venue/site authorities and delivery teams.
  • Provide guidance on venue build-out and technology services implementation, including commissioning and decommissioning of tournament venues.
  • Collaborate with assigned personnel and Stadium partners to enable/support timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with governance structures and PMO systems.
  • Manage on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to IT Command Centre.

Your profile

  • University degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years IT experience and at least 4 years in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports/major event industry is required
  • Proven track record of delivering complex IT programs and projects
  • Experience managing teams in similar projects
  • Knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Up-to-date knowledge of event-related technologies, including CATV, radio communications, wired communications, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual
  • Strong professional demeanor and cross-group collaboration skills
  • Ability to lead virtual teams, manage conflicts, and drive consensus to meet milestones
  • Leadership and ability to motivate team members
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and facilitation skills
  • Ability to adapt communication to diverse audiences
  • Leadership and accountability across relevant areas
  • Strong political acumen and adaptability to various working environments
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in additional FIFA languages (FR/ES/GER) is an asset
  • Willingness to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some longer trips (15 days or more)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more

Overview

Are you ready to embark on a career with a company that places both its employees and customers at the heart of everything we do? If you're a motivated, customer-focused individual with a can-do attitude, we want to hear from you.

You’ll fit in well with us at Medstrom, where we have disrupted the market by providing proven and well-evidenced products and services to our busy customers, helping to make a real difference to both their workload and, crucially, their patients’ outcomes.

Established in 2010, Medstrom has grown substantially by being patient-focused to become the organisation we are today, whilst maintaining an open culture and ethos. In 2022, Medstrom became an Employee Ownership Trust (EOT), unlike any other company in the industry. This allows each employee to have a vested interest in the company, where we can all contribute to and share in the company’s success.

We’re now looking for a Cleaning Technician to join our Oxford team on a full-time, permanent basis, working at our Thame service centre.

Benefits

  • Competitive basic salary of up to £24,500
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • 33 days’ annual leave entitlement
  • Discounts and cashback on shopping, supermarkets, and holidays as part of our rewards scheme
  • Salary Sacrifice Schemes, including Cycle to Work

  • Receive a treat on your birthday
  • Death in Service benefit provided
  • Be a part of an Employee Ownership Trust (EOT) and the associated benefits of having a stake in the company

Your Role

As a Cleaning Technician, you will clean, maintain, and support the delivery of our products to customers throughout Oxfordshire, based within our service centre in Thame.

Whilst adhering to established quality processes, you’ll clean and test products, ensuring they are ready for use, providing a high level of service to our internal technicians who will install products at customer sites.

Responsibilities

  • Cleaning, decontaminating, testing, and repairing products and making them ready for use
  • Keeping an inventory of products and spare parts
  • Ensuring compliance with quality processes, both internal and external
  • Meeting daily product preparation targets
  • Delivering a timely and appropriate service to in-field technicians
  • Completing and recording electrical safety testing on products during tasks – you will be fully trained
  • Completing tasks within the laundry (booking in, drying and inspection)

  • Completing daily/weekly activity reports

Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday

About You

  • Basic knowledge of hygiene and safety rules would be an advantage, but is not essential

Personal Requirements

  • The ability to work on your own initiative and follow procedures laid out by the business to achieve deadlines
  • A proactive, ‘can-do’ attitude with a flexible outlook
  • Please note, this role will involve manual activities.

In addition to the salary and related benefits, you will join a company that has grown extensively within the last five years and, through our unique ownership model, is continuing to grow, whilst offering great career opportunities for those who are keen to progress.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.
Buscamos um Analista N2 Pleno para cuidar da parte técnica da rede e apoiar a expansão da empresa.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

Jornada / Modelo

  • Regime: CLT – 44h semanais
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

title: Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis, em Santa Catarina (SC). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

  • Elaborar relatórios e books gerenciais com dados estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão das lideranças;

Qualificações

Graduação em Psicologia,AdministraçãoouEngenharias;

Pósgraduaçãoem áreascorrelatas ;

Sólida experiênciaem RH e seus subsistemas;

Português Brasileiroe Inglês fluentes;

Experiência no setor de energia elétricae comercializadoras.

Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.
